nodes.rationale: Concurrent edits are resolved through server version and stock-balance checks, rather than last-write-wins.

nodes.label: Negative Stock Policy
nodes.rationale: When negative stock is disallowed, excess reductions are blocked and kept only as a local draft; when allowed, the local negative balance is visibly flagged for later review.

nodes.label: Offline Business Capabilities

nodes.label: No Last-Write-Wins for Financial Documents
nodes.rationale: Financial and inventory records require explicit resolution to protect ledger integrity.

nodes.label: Server-Confirmed Operations

nodes.label: Atomic Pull and Checkpoint Commit
nodes.rationale: The cursor is persisted only after the Room pull transaction succeeds, preventing missed server changes.

nodes.label: Authentication Expiry Recovery
nodes.rationale: A 401 stops sync, returns in-flight rows to PENDING, and preserves local offline data.

nodes.label: Exponential Backoff Retry
nodes.rationale: Temporary network, timeout, and server failures are retried with capped exponential delay to limit battery and server load.

nodes.label: Interrupted Processing Recovery
nodes.rationale: On startup, PROCESSING outbox rows return to PENDING so an interruption cannot strand or lose a queued event.

nodes.label: Permanent Validation Rejection
nodes.rationale: A 422 validation failure moves the event and document to REJECTED and stops automatic retries.

nodes.label: Crash Recovery
nodes.rationale: The first sync step returns PROCESSING events to PENDING so interrupted work can be retried.

nodes.label: Personal Finance RBAC Isolation
nodes.rationale: Business roles need an explicit personal-finance grant unless the member is the owner.

nodes.label: Confirmed Journal-Based Financial Reporting
nodes.rationale: Official statements are computed strictly from confirmed journal entries.

nodes.label: Idempotent Personal Recurring Obligations
nodes.rationale: Idempotency prevents duplicate recurring transactions on repeated scheduler runs.

nodes.label: Central Entitlement Enforcement Layers

attributes.rationale: A shared modular backend avoids distributed transaction hazards across accounting, inventory, and multi-payment operations while retaining domain boundaries.
Breaking contract changes require a new major API path and a deprecation window, while compatible additions can remain in v1.
Deep-link parameters cannot grant or mutate entitlements; clients fetch the authoritative server snapshot.
Every confirmed financial event is posted as an atomic voucher whose debits equal its credits.
Independent commercial, payment, accounting, stock, and sync states avoid overloading one status enum.
Metadata updates cannot overwrite balances or transaction history, and historical accounts cannot be deleted.
Missing category mappings fail explicitly instead of posting to an arbitrary suspense account.
One shared core avoids distributed transaction hazards while keeping domain modules isolated.
Owner withdrawals are equity drawings and must not be recorded as operating expenses.

nodes.label: Personal Finance and Business P&L Separation

attributes.rationale: Personal living costs must not distort business profitability, taxes, or financial statements.

nodes.norm_label: personal finance and business p&l separation

attributes.rationale: Row-level security and tenant separation isolate organization data.
Sensitive permissions are not aliased to broad read permissions, and unauthorized access is audited.
Settled cheques block financial edits; posted corrections require audit evidence and adjustment accounting.
The web admin panel consumes versioned REST APIs and does not connect directly to PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Variant-Level Stock Ledger with Parent Projection

attributes.rationale: Variant stock is tracked independently under a transaction lock, and parent stock is derived as the sum of variants.
